description: Source code implementing string utility functions for Windows in the google_breakpad project, including functions for getting base filename and safe conversions between multibyte and wide character strings.

classes.name: WindowsStringUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for string conversions and filename manipulation on Windows.

methods.name: GetBaseName
methods.description: Extracts the base filename from a given path, handling both '/' and '\' as directory separators.

methods.name: safe_mbstowcs
methods.description: Converts a multibyte string to a wide string safely, handling buffer size and errors.

methods.name: safe_wcstombs
methods.description: Converts a wide string to a multibyte string safely, handling buffer size and errors.
